ref_date_note: Mon 12/8/2025 (posted Sun 12/7), subtitle 'Some Solid (A) Potential Setups'. Z (Dec) contract per batch, no roll mention. ES Friday's low and high not given numerically -> FRI_LOW / FRI_HIGH. ES abbreviations resolved to 68xx (ARH 6890.5): 63-64 = 11/28 & 12/2 highs 6863-6864; 73 / 73-74 = Friday VAL 6873/6874; 88 = Friday VAH; 91-93, 80-83, 66.5-69, 50-53, IB-low example 56 (hypothetical, not a zone). es1 targets 80-83, 88, 91-93; 'Once back above 73' and 'be careful that 73 doesn't reject from below (take profit...)' put in stop_hint rather than as a target. es2 is conditional and he says 'it is too risky to plan a trade lower ahead of time' / 'If the session provides a good setup ... I'll consider it' (hold/LBAF of 6850-6853 targeting 66.5-69) - included ungraded because it names a level. es3 gate = ARH 6890.5 through 91-93 ('Any kind of LAAF of the ARH or 91-93'); 'could reasonably come from as high as 6898-6901 but I would need to see something compelling' kept in stop_hint. es4/es5 (Friday value probe: long hold/LBAF of 73-74, short fail/LAAF of 88) are ungraded and have no stated targets -> the other value edge / nearby levels (es4: 6880-6883, 6888; es5: 6880-6883, 6873-6874). es6 LAAF of Friday's high is 'valid' but ungraded; no target stated -> 91-93 then es3's targets 80-83, 73. NQ abbreviations resolved to 25xxx (25700/25823-25836 listed). nq2: 'mindful of 700-713' kept in stop_hint, targets 726 then 761-769. nq3 is the conditional 'if NQ tests 823-836 or so, sees a weakish sell side response, and then holds 761-769 from above I'll consider a long' - ungraded; no target given -> 823-836 then FRI_HIGH ('no clean path above 769 to Friday's high because of supply ... roughly 797-836'). Not transcribed: shorting NQ supply 797-836 ('I can't plan to short supply up there'); 'I also won't take a reclaim long of 761-769 outright'.

trades.name: LBAF of Friday's low
trades.quote: Given Friday’s poor low and the fact that the 11/28 and 12/2 highs sit in the 63-64 range, I see a LBAF of Friday’s low as a highly valid trade. Once back above 73 I would expect 80-83 to print with potential for 88 and 91-93. Monitor for continuation at each level and from there. This is a solid A setup, just be careful that 73 doesn’t reject from below (take profit, raise stop to even, whatever your risk preference).
trades.stop_hint: Once back above 73 ... just be careful that 73 doesn’t reject from below (take profit, raise stop to even, whatever your risk preference).

trades.name: Conditional hold/LBAF of 6850-6853 (session-dependent)
trades.quote: If the session provides a good setup (imagine for example the IB low at 56 and then a LBAF the IB low into 50-53) for doing so, then I’ll consider it given the fact that a hold of 50-53 has potential to retest 66.5-69
trades.stop_hint: As mentioned in the weekly plan a LBAF could certainly come from lower, but it is too risky to plan a trade lower ahead of time.

trades.name: LAAF of ARH 6890.5 or 6891-6893
trades.quote: Any kind of LAAF of the ARH or 91-93 is a valid short targeting 80-83, 73, and 66.5-69. I’ll rate this a A as well.
trades.stop_hint: has well-defined risk (the high which produces the LAAF). A LAAF of 91-93 could reasonably come from as high as 6898-6901 but I would need to see something compelling in the session to enter directly with a short.

trades.name: Hold/LBAF of 6873-6874 (Friday VAL)
trades.quote: So we can look for longs on a hold or LBAF of 73-74 and shorts on a fail or LAAF of 88.

trades.name: Fail/LAAF of 6888 (Friday VAH)
trades.quote: So we can look for longs on a hold or LBAF of 73-74 and shorts on a fail or LAAF of 88.

trades.name: LAAF of Friday's high
trades.quote: A LAAF of Friday’s high has potential to produce bearish results and is valid but anything like that requires a tight leash until 91-93 becomes firm resistance.
trades.stop_hint: requires a tight leash until 91-93 becomes firm resistance

trades.name: Fail/LAAF of 25761-25769
trades.quote: Short a fail or LAAF of 761-769 is an A setup for the same reasons as ES. Friday’s ARH and VAH sit right at 760.5 so that adds some nice clean confluence. I would target 726, 700, 683, and 651-669 monitoring for continuation at each spot and beyond.

trades.name: Hold/LBAF of 25651-25669
trades.quote: Long a hold or LBAF of 651-669 is also an A setup.
trades.stop_hint: I would be mindful of 700-713 or so given the amount of dip buying seen there Friday

trades.name: Hold of 25761-25769 from above after test of 25823-25836
trades.quote: I also won’t take a reclaim long of 761-769 outright, but if NQ tests 823-836 or so, sees a weakish sell side response, and then holds 761-769 from above I’ll consider a long.
